_comment: Floating damage numbers (#85). Presentation only: changing these needs no WireCodec.BUILD bump. Seconds, metres and metres per second; motion is scaled up with camera distance so the spray keeps its on-screen size.

motion._comment: Each number leaves the impact point along the hit normal (outward), fans sideways (spread, golden-angle around the normal) and is thrown up (up), then falls under gravity with linear drag. offset lifts the spawn point off the struck face.

timing._comment: A number pops to pop_scale over pop_seconds, settles, and fades out over the last fade_seconds of lifetime_seconds. Hits from one attacker on one target within merge_seconds of the previous one add to the live number (minigun, flamer) until it is merge_span_seconds old.

text._comment: Text height is screen_fraction of the view height at the number's distance, clamped to min/max_height metres, then scaled from small_scale to big_scale as damage rises to big_damage. Hits below min_damage show nothing. max_live caps numbers on screen (oldest recycled first).

colors._comment: Outgoing hits blend small -> mid -> big with damage; hits on your own bot use incoming.
